purpose: Historical development backtests, not an untouched research test: 2026 outcomes already appeared in full-pool diagnostics.
selection_rule: Choose model/settings using historical backtests only; freeze before any Swiss 2026 outcomes. Do not describe the earlier September Elo test as untouched.
unknown_missing_games: Provisional source series and publication times remain limitations. No claim of official complete-series recovery.
target_context: Unknown future map side is excluded from deployable inputs or marginalized under a documented pre-draft selection model. Conditional-on-realized-side diagnostics are separate from tournament forecast evaluation.
historical_prior_policy: Only records available before each fold may inform priors or preprocessing. Earlier team effects are season-specific. Cross-season regional bridges must be reviewed and specified before fitting.
temporal_specification: Not finalized; requires discussion before fitting a temporal variant.
uncertainty: Do not treat games from the same series as independent replicates for confidence intervals. Model posterior uncertainty is distinct from evaluation sampling uncertainty.
prospective_evaluation: The frozen post-draw Worlds 2026 Swiss forecast is evaluated separately once outcomes occur, without updating its initial predictions.
